correctness.rationale: Write X=d-log U, so X has positive drift d, variance v=pi²/4, bilateral transform M(s)=e^(-ds)/cos(pi*s/2) and finite exponential moments for |Re s|<1. N=sum_{n>=0}1{S_n<L}. For G(L)=sum_{n>=1}P(S_n<L), Laplace transform is M(s)/[s(1-M(s))] on small positive real line, absolutely integrable vertically due to hyperbolic-cosine decay. Its only pole in a thin strip around the imaginary axis is double at zero, with principal part 1/(d s²)+[(d²+v)/(2d²)-1]/s; contour shift yields G=L/d+(d²+v)/(2d²)-1+O(e^-delta L), then add n=0. First-passage tau_L has centered Gaussian fluctuations from random-index CLT, positive drift and negligible overshoot. The post-first-passage revisit count is dominated by an independent sum V=sum_{j>=1}1{S_j<0} with E V<=M(s)/(1-M(s))<infinity, making N-tau tight and preserving the Gaussian limit. Independent symbolic M first/second derivative checks passed. The exponential error is only fixed zeta; no incorrect monotone count assumption.
